body:
**Tier:** T4 (tenancy / PII: which people a coach can read).
**Why:** `GET /coach/cross-pillar/search` and `GET /coach/cross-pillar/clients/:email` called the OWNER-only `FederationService` platform-wide. Any coach could reach them.
**T4 trigger scan:** tenancy and PII, yes (this fix narrows access). Money, auth tokens, credentials, destructive data, schema: none.
**T3 trigger scan:** a contract change for non-owner callers only. Coaches now get their own clients. A foreign email returns 404. Response shapes are unchanged. Mobile needs no change.
**Bounded T1:** none.
**Canonical builder:** AUDIT-13-125 (Claude Opus 5.5, agent 125).
**Acceptance evidence:** the new `test/cross-pillar-coach-scope.spec.ts` (6 tests) passes locally. It fails on main, because the old `search(query, limit)` / `getClient(email)` returned everyone. `test/cross-pillar.service.spec.ts` was updated to the new signature and passes. The PR CI runs the full suite and tsc.

## B fixed
**B-A13-1 (private data to the wrong person).** A coach opens Settings > Both pillars view, picks "Both", and types a letter in search. They then see the name, email, role and coach of every person on TGP, including other coaches' clients. Opening any of those people by email shows their 7-day activity counts and, when the finance side is connected, a finance summary (net worth, assets, debts).
- `src/coach/cross-pillar/cross-pillar.service.ts`: `search` and `getClient` now take the caller's id and role. For non-owners the search covers only users with `coach_id = caller, role = student, deleted_at = null`. `getClient` returns a 404 for any email outside that roster, before any profile is read. The OWNER keeps the platform-wide view, which is the same rule `getClients` already uses.
- `src/admin/federation/federation.service.ts`: `unifiedSearch` takes an optional `restrictToUserIds`. When it is set, the fitness query is limited to those ids and finance-only hits are dropped. The admin console calls (no third argument) are unchanged.
- `src/coach/cross-pillar/cross-pillar.controller.ts`: passes `req.user.id` and `req.user.role` through.

Sub-coaches (`coach_id` is the head coach's) now get an empty search. That is safe. Widening to their assigned clients is a follow-up (C).

No migration, no new dependency, no lockfile, no new flag, no `as any`. Clinic partner not named. No secrets.
title: fix(cross-pillar): coach search and client profile only reach the coach's own clients (AUDIT-13-125, T4)
